targetText:
Let us assume a circulating capital of £2,500, four-fifths of which,
or £2,000, are constant capital (materials of production) and one-fifth,
or £500, is variable capital invested in wages.
explanation: Marx analyzes how the turnover rate of variable capital (wages) affects the annual rate of surplus value. Faster turnover means the same amount of wage-capital can exploit more total labor over a year.
